Two-headed Pteranodon with a 150 foot wingspan. Creator of typhoons, sleeps in a volcano caldera. Many consider her a goddess.

AC 15, HP 114, ATK 3 talon (near) +10 (3d8) or dual lightning breath, MV far (fly), S +6, D +3, C +6, I -3, W +4, Ch +3, AL C, LV 24

Dual Lightning Breath. Two straight lines (5' wide) extending far from Agyra. DEX 15+ or 5d6 damage (DISADV on check if wearing metal armor).

Immortal. Only damaged by magic sources. Immune to acid, cold, fire, and lightning. If slain, resurrects in 1d10 days and flees.

Typhoon. As an action, summon a hurricane wind that lasts for 1d10 hours and stretches for miles.
